name: Newport (the first U.S. Open's links on Rhode Island Sound)
note: Course theme palette (<= 32 colours; same keys as pnw.json plus F0-F2). Newport Country Club, from the developer's photos (release assorted-lidar-data, newport.1-7) and NAIP: deep, saturated fairways and greens; a deep olive rough with a tawny cast of fescue (F0-F2) beyond a mown band; warm tan bunker sand; the steel-blue Atlantic beyond Ocean Drive and its dark rocky shore; green estate lawns and fields out of bounds (L0-L2). Trees in assets-src/trees_newport.py: black pine, spruce, maple, oak and copper beech. Shadows are a 35% black overlay on top of these.
